messages:
alex-h: Heads-up — onboarding call with a new Redwood Dedicated customer (Acme AI). They want eu-west-1 Dedicated with committed throughput options. Target: 6k tokens/s sustained, up to 10k tokens/s burst, p99 latency goal <150ms. Can we sketch sizing + risks?

maria-l: good to know. do we have their model profile and average response length? that affects batching a lot.

alex-h: they said ~2k context windows, avg response ~150 tokens, model similar to a quantized Llama-family 70B. KV cache expected hit ~25%. mix of chat + some embedding calls.

samir: quick back-of-envelope: throughput depends heavily on GPU class + batching. with H100-style decode perf and tuned batching we typically see ~1200 tokens/s per GPU for this workload. so 6k sustained -> ~5 gpus. with burst and headroom factor we land ~8 gpus. recommend reserving a small safety margin (10 GPUs).

jen-ops: can you paste that calc so finance and sales have something concrete?

samir: calc:
```
target_sustained = 6000 tokens/s
per_gpu_throughput ≈ 1200 tokens/s (batched, prefix cache in use)
gpus_needed = ceil(6000 / 1200) = 5
operational_buffer = +60% -> 5 * 1.6 = 8 -> round up to 10 for rolling upgrades and canaries
```
assumptions: batch size ~16, effective kv cache hit 25%, avg token latency ~60ms for p50.

natalie-ps: region note: eu-west-1 H100 availability is patchy next quarter. A100 80GB availability is more reliable but ~15-25% lower throughput. if we plan A100s, change per_gpu_throughput to ~950 tokens/s -> sustained GPUs = ceil(6000/950)=7 -> buffer -> 11 GPUs.

alex-h: so two plausible reserve plans: 10x H100 (if capacity exists) or 11x A100. which one is less risky from procurement side?

billing-bot: projected monthly cost estimates (high-level):
- A100 reserved (10 GPUs, eu-west-1): $72,000/mo reserved, on-demand equivalent ~$110,000/mo.
- H100 reserved (8 GPUs): $96,000/mo reserved, on-demand equivalent ~$140,000/mo.
(rough estimates include infra premium & support addon; will refine with Finance)

maria-l: recommendation: start the customer on 10 A100-equivalent reserved GPUs in eu-west-1 for first 90 days, enable automatic on-demand burst capacity for up to +20% traffic. that minimizes risk from H100 supply issues and is cheaper than on-demand. sales can upsell H100 migration once usage stabilizes.

jen-ops: ops checklist: set up VPC peering + sufficient NIC throughput per instance, pre-warm KV cache on rollout, configure autoscale cooldown to 90s, add canary pool of 2 GPUs to validate model version. Also ensure cross-az traffic is minimized to avoid egress throttles.

alex-h: agreed. I'll put that in the customer proposal: reserve 10 A100-equivalent GPUs + optional 4-GPU burst credit, SLA 99.9, canary 2 GPUs for first week. @maria-l can you draft cost appendix for sales?

maria-l: yep, will draft and send by EOD with tiered commit options and breakeven analysis vs on-demand. :thumbsup:

samir: ops follow-ups: add metrics to monitor — kv_hit_rate, batch_size, p50/p95/p99 token latency, queue_time, per-route token/sec. I'll share a Grafana query after this thread.

jen-ops: created ticket INFRA-1142 to provision the pool + peering + runbooks. I'll attach runbook skeleton. :white_check_mark:

alex-h: perfect. thanks everyone. we'll surface these numbers in the customer onboarding packet and sync with finance for final pricing.
